game.name: Display: Sony Trinitron (4:3 CRT)
game.desc: Switches to the Trinitron setup and reboots. 640x480 output for the HDMI-to-composite converter, no CRT shaders (the tube does that), color correction for handhelds. Works on either TV, so picking the wrong one is harmless.

game.name: Display: HDMI TV (16:9 flat panel)
game.desc: Switches to the flat-panel setup and reboots. 1080p output with the Trinitron-simulating CRT shader for consoles and LCD shaders for handhelds.
